content_sections.heading: KSRTC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Chief Engineer (Projects & Civil Works): B.Tech. in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification recognized by University of Kerala. Retired Chief Engineers from PWD/CPWD, engaged in the design and construction of major buildings. Minimum 10 years of experience in the construction of buildings. Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical): B.Tech. In Electrical Engineering degree or equivalent qualification recognized by University of Kerala. Minimum ten (10) years’ experience as Assistant Engineer (Electrical) or equivalent from Government departments / Government projects or with an A Class Contractor license for Assistant Engineer (Electrical) or equivalent position.

content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the KSRTC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of KSRTC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for KSRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Kerala State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC) via the Centre for Management Development (CMD) for filling technical positions on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced in the KSRTC Notification 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for the posts of Chief Engineer (Projects & Civil Works) and Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical) under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the start date for submitting the online application?
faq.answer: The online application process officially commences on 26 September 2026, allowing eligible candidates to submit their forms through the designated portal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for KSRTC Jobs 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application form is 9 October 2026. Candidates must complete their submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for Chief Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Chief Engineer post must possess a B.Tech. in Civil Engineering or an equivalent qualification recognized by the University of Kerala, along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical)?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical) position must hold a B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering degree or equivalent qualification recognized by the University of Kerala along with required professional experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 65 years for the Chief Engineer post and 50 years for the Assistant Executive Engineer position as specified in the recruitment guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Assistant Executive Engineer?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical) post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply exclusively through online mode by visiting the official Centre for Management Development (CMD) website at www.cmd.kerala.gov.in and uploading required documents.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for KSRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises scrutiny of submitted applications, an interview of shortlisted candidates, and any additional evaluation tests if deemed necessary by KSRTC or CMD.
